extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: Tamika discussed Aetna plans with Ms. Whitfield, scheduling a plan review for 3 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: Tamika asked, 'What matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?' This question may be seen as leading the customer to choose the lowest premium, which could be considered a superlative. To improve, Tamika could rephrase the question to focus on the customer's needs and preferences.
